units.label: Overview: eight parts of speech (text)
units.content_summary: English words are grouped into eight parts of speech based on their function: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction, interjection. This lesson introduces the four most common.

units.label: Noun and verb definitions (text)
units.content_summary: Noun: names a person, place, thing, or idea (dog, city, happiness). Verb: expresses an action or state of being (run, is, seems).

units.label: Adjective and adverb definitions (text)
units.content_summary: Adjective: describes a noun (blue, tall, happy). Adverb: describes a verb, adjective, or another adverb, often ending in -ly (quickly, very, well).

units.label: Parts of speech chart (image)
units.content_summary: Colour-coded chart with an example sentence 'The quick fox jumps gracefully' with each word labeled: The(article), quick(adjective), fox(noun), jumps(verb), gracefully(adverb).

units.label: Worked example: label a sentence (text)
units.content_summary: Sentence 'She sings beautifully in the old theater' is labeled word-by-word: She(pronoun), sings(verb), beautifully(adverb), old(adjective), theater(noun).

units.label: Practice: identify parts of speech (text)
units.content_summary: Five sentences given; students identify the noun, verb, adjective, and adverb in each.
